basic_profile.bio: Hailing from Portland, Oregon, I am a 47-year-old IT consultant with a passion for understanding the nuances of internet culture. Married for over 15 years, I often explore topics related to relationship dynamics and digital privacy. When I'm not engrossed in tech projects, I enjoy hiking the Pacific Northwest trails or diving deep into social and political discussions online. My evenings are typically spent browsing Reddit, usually between 8 PM and midnight, after winding down from a day of work and family commitments.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and over two decades in the IT industry, I've developed a keen interest in digital security and online communities. My knowledge is mostly self-taught, supplemented by continuous learning through online courses and tech forums. I enjoy dissecting internet trends and analyzing their societal impacts.
